question: Is the Draper storm route cannibalizing the four fixed commercial roofing queries, or is the main page failing to match broad commercial intent?

decision.summary: The exact Draper mobile panel finds no Frame URL in the top 30 for any of the four commercial queries, and the targeted Search Console query-to-page request returns no rows for those same four queries. The storm child has aggregate page visibility for storm-specific demand, but no measured evidence associates it with the fixed commercial queries. The main page is heavily linked and self-canonical, but its title and H1 emphasize premium reroofing rather than the broader roofing-contractor intent used by the fixed panel.
limits: A Search Console targeted request with no returned row means unknown or withheld demand, not zero impressions and not proof that no URL is indexed.
The committed Search Console window is blended across devices and ends three days before collection; the DataForSEO panel is fixed mobile Android in Draper.
The storm page's aggregate Search Console visibility and the retained storm-query rows are separate observations; exact storm-query-to-URL attribution was not requested by this commercial panel.
Service-area inclusion for Draper on the current Salt Lake Valley profile remains unverified, so this diagnosis does not authorize GBP, Maps, hasMap, or sameAs changes.

hypotheses.why: The fixed SERP leaders use broad roofing-company or roofing-contractor intent. Draper's main title and H1 use the narrower premium-reroofing framing, while the target phrase roofing contractor is absent from visible main-page copy.

The exact Salt Lake Valley CID does not appear in any of the four Draper local packs, and Draper's current profile service-area inclusion has not been verified. This can affect Maps and broader local prominence but does not authorize a profile mutation.

The storm child is self-canonical, narrowly storm-scoped, and has only two internal links versus 49 for the main page. The targeted commercial query-to-page request returned no Draper rows, so no fixed commercial query is measured against the storm child.

The informational guide has an exact roof-replacement title but only one internal link. No targeted fixed-query row currently attributes roof replacement draper to it; preserve both routes and watch future multi-URL evidence.

guardrails: No material regression in storm-child Search Console clicks, impressions, or average position compared with the declared pre-experiment window.
